predictive_objective: Cost-aware 3-state classification LONG, SHORT, NO_TRADE of potential 60s executable USD net PnL; optimize trading expectancy not accuracy
symbol: EURUSDm Exness Standard indicative Bid/Ask archive, actual MT5 specifications pending

anchor_sampling.anchor: First tick timestamp >= each UTC 10-minute grid slot, must arrive <=2000ms after slot
anchor_sampling.no_overlap: Max label horizon 300s; 600s separation across all sampled anchors
anchor_sampling.quote_timestamp_tie_policy: Preserve original sequence, for before-time lookups choose last quote <= boundary; after-time lookups first quote >= boundary; no future quotes in features

label_rule.future_quote: first quote timestamp >= target, require lateness <=2000ms; otherwise censored
label_rule.entry: first quote timestamp >= signal time+100ms, require <=2000ms lateness
label_rule.baseline_execution: Buy Ask+1 point, close Bid-1 point; Sell Bid-1 point, close Ask+1 point; $0.01 per EURUSD point for 0.01 lot
label_rule.class_assignment: LONG when net long >0.04 USD and > net short; SHORT if net short >0.04 and > net long; otherwise NO_TRADE
label_rule.missing: drop anchors with missing primary outcome; never forward fill beyond 2000ms
label_rule.profit_target_training: Use quote-side 60s counterfactual payoff for class labels; final trading performance additionally enforces intrahorizon SL/TP and margin

past_only_features: trailing 60s absolute mid move sum points

model_comparison.statistical_baseline: sklearn LogisticRegression multinomial, StandardScaler, C=1.0, max_iter=1000, random_state=22
model_comparison.ai: LightGBM LGBMClassifier, n_estimators=180, learning_rate=0.05, num_leaves=7, max_depth=3, min_child_samples=70, colsample_bytree=0.8, random_state=22, n_jobs=2, verbosity=-1
model_comparison.cost_aware_decision: For each predicted P(class), compute EV_long and EV_short by multiplying probabilities with TRAINING-ONLY average net action PnL per true class; take higher side if EV >= +0.02USD and difference from other action >=0.01USD and spread <=10pt; otherwise NO_TRADE
model_comparison.class_support: if fewer than 25 examples for any class, report MODEL_UNAVAILABLE, no synthetic class repairs

walk_forward.train: Expanding all earlier months, purged events whose t+300s or any label extends into eval start; do not train on any future
walk_forward.historical_label: retrospective development only; Jul-Oct 2026 is NOT clean OOS (prior V21 research)

risk_and_execution.stop_order: Preplaced broker-registered SL/TP simulated at filled entry, not demonstrated accepted by MT5; BUY stop triggers Bid, SELL stop triggers Ask, fill at first available quote after stop delay with adverse slip
risk_and_execution.stress_spread_definition: preserve quote midpoint, widen bid/ask around midpoint, rerun stops with chronological ticks
risk_and_execution.commission_status: Exness Standard public terms zero; verify actual account
risk_and_execution.swap: zero only for confirmed day trade closed before broker rollover; invalid otherwise
risk_and_execution.margin_usd: contract_eur * entry_price / leverage, check free margin before entry; margin call/stop out specific details uncalibrated

research_report: monthly trading PnL and trade counts

prospective_gate.monthly_consistency: positive net trading PnL in >=60% of complete prospective months and no one month contributes >50% of positive profit
prospective_gate.execution_validation: Need actual MT5 symbol stopsLevel/freezeLevel, order rejection stats, timestamps for requests/deals, realized commission, swap, margin and slippage before live order
prospective_gate.winner_rule: at most one model only after the independent prospective gate; if none, NO_EDGE. Never reoptimize an earlier registered strategy on failed prospective history.
